decisions.rationale: "enzyme deficiency" is a generic descriptor of reduced enzyme activity rather than a named disease. The term "deficiency" is a general term and is not annotated on its own.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4. Do not annotate general terms

decisions.rationale: "haemolysis" denotes a pathological biological process (red blood cell destruction) reported as a sign, not a disease name, so it is not annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 5. Do not annotate references to biological processes

decisions.rationale: "G6PD deficiency" names one specific, well-defined disease (glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency) with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease. Like "C7 deficiency" in the examples, the word "deficiency" is part of the disease name here.
decisions.guideline_section: 1. Annotate all Specific Disease mentions; Examples 6 (C7 deficiency)
